summary.text: Jubilee McGill is a Democratic state representative from Vermont who has represented the Addison-5 District since January 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has worked for nonprofits on affordable housing and homelessness and founded Addison County Mutual Aid.

paragraphs.text: Jubilee McGill was born in Middlebury, Vermont, and lives in Bridport.
According to Ballotpedia, she earned a degree in business.
Her career experience includes working for nonprofits managing affordable housing and advocating to eradicate homelessness in Vermont.
McGill founded Addison County Mutual Aid and was first seated in the Vermont House of Representatives on January 4, 2023.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
